top_risks.title: Template command execution without whitelist enforcement
top_risks.remediation: Wire IsWhitelisted(ExtractProgramName(job.Command)) into RealExecutor before executing any command. The whitelist module exists but is never called.

top_risks.title: Agent update binary download lacks integrity verification
top_risks.remediation: Implement SHA256 checksum verification in the agent updater (matching coordinator updater's VerifyChecksum pattern). Distribute checksums alongside release assets.

top_risks.title: SMB credential fields passed unsanitized to cmdkey utility
top_risks.remediation: Validate host contains only safe characters (alphanumeric, dots, hyphens). Sanitize username and password for special characters before passing to cmdkey.

top_risks.title: All credential profiles decrypted and returned to any agent token
top_risks.remediation: Scope credential decryption to only the credential profile assigned to the requesting agent's own jobs. Require per-job authorization for credential access.

audit_notes: Two critical findings removed (Hardcoded JWT secret and admin token in config.json) reclassified as test/dev only — production uses env vars exclusively. Resolution count bumped by 4 to match total delta (80→76). Score recalculated: 10.0 - (42+48+12)/321 = 9.68.

2026-07-13 HARDENING PASS: four additional findings resolved — (1) password policy: validatePasswordStrength() enforces min 8 chars + 4 character classes (upper, lower, digit, special) server-side in auth.go and business/users.go; (2) admin route protection: user management endpoints (GET/POST/DELETE /api/users, PUT /api/users/{id}/role) swapped from JWTMiddleware to adminRoute with RequirePasswordChange and RequireRole('admin'); (3) admin UI protection: route-level role guards (meta: requiresRole) on federation, users, groups, alerts, credentials routes, plus credentials nav gating with v-if="isAdmin"; (4) pagination hardening: MaxPage = 10000 cap added, constants extracted (DefaultLimit=25, MaxLimit=100). Score recalculated: 9.72.

remediation_priority.finding: SMB credential fields passed unsanitized to cmdkey utility
remediation_priority.recommendation: Add input validation on credential map values before passing to cmdkey; allow only safe character patterns for host, username, and password

remediation_priority.finding: Template command execution without whitelist enforcement
remediation_priority.recommendation: Wire existing IsWhitelisted() function into RealExecutor.execCommand to enforce program allowlist before execution

remediation_priority.finding: Agent update binary download lacks integrity verification
remediation_priority.recommendation: Port SHA256 checksum verification from coordinator/updater/updater.go to agent/updater/updater.go; verify binary hash before executing update

remediation_priority.finding: All credential profiles decrypted and returned to any agent token
remediation_priority.recommendation: Add agent_id ownership check before decrypting credentials in job list endpoint; only decrypt credentials for jobs assigned to the requesting agent
